# pangolin_idp (Resource)

Manages a global OIDC Identity Provider.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `auth_url` (String) The authorization URL.
- `client_id` (String) The client ID.
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) The client secret.
- `identifier_path` (String) The identifier path.
- `name` (String) The name of the IdP.
- `scopes` (String) The scopes.
- `token_url` (String) The token URL.

### Optional

- `auto_provision` (Boolean) Whether to auto-provision users.
- `default_org_mapping` (String) The default organization mapping to map a user to an organization. This property uses [JMES](https://jmespath.org/tutorial.html) syntax for mapping.
- `default_role_mapping` (String) The default role mapping to map a user to a role. This property uses [JMES](https://jmespath.org/tutorial.html) syntax for mapping.
- `email_path` (String) The email path (nullable).
- `name_path` (String) The name path (nullable).
- `variant` (String) The IdP variant (oidc, google, azure).

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of the IdP.
- `redirect_url` (String) The redirect URL for this IDP.
